# dbaas_instance (Data Source)

Read an authorized instance's specification, convergence status and public connection/TLS metadata. Runtime metadata failures fail the read. Does not retrieve application credentials or connection profiles.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) DBaaS instance ID.
- `zone` (String) Exact configured DBaaS zone name or UUID. Use the computed UUID for subsequent operations.

### Read-Only

- `connection_info` (Attributes) Public endpoint and TLS trust metadata. Null until the instance is Ready. Optional engine-specific strings are empty when inapplicable. No application passwords or credential-bearing profiles are retrieved. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_info))
- `created_at` (String) instance creation time
- `deleted_at` (String) terminal deletion time
- `desired_generation` (Number) latest desired-state generation
- `engine` (String) catalog engine ID
- `name` (String) instance name
- `observed_generation` (Number) generation reached by reconciliation
- `plan` (String) catalog plan ID
- `recovery_until` (String) last instant when retained recovery may be requested
- `source_cidrs` (List of String) source IPv4 CIDRs allowed to reach the database
- `state` (String) instance state
- `storage_gib` (Number) persistent storage per data-bearing node in GiB
- `topology` (String) catalog topology ID
- `updated_at` (String) instance update time
- `version` (String) catalog engine version
- `zone_id` (String) CloudStack zone ID
- `zone_name` (String) Installed CloudStack zone name

<a id="nestedatt--connection_info"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connection_info`

Read-Only:

- `bootstrap_servers` (String) Kafka bootstrap servers
- `broker_endpoints` (List of String) Kafka advertised broker endpoints
- `ca_bundle_filename` (String) stable PEM CA-bundle filename
- `ca_bundle_valid_from` (String) start of the CA bundle validity intersection
- `ca_bundle_valid_until` (String) end of the CA bundle validity intersection
- `ca_bundle_version` (String) content revision of the PEM CA bundle
- `ca_certificate` (String) PEM certificate authority for TLS server verification
- `host` (String) database host
- `instance_id` (String) DBaaS instance ID
- `port` (Number) database port
- `protocol` (String) verified client protocol
- `server_certificate_valid_from` (String) start of the serving certificate validity intersection
- `server_certificate_valid_until` (String) end of the serving certificate validity intersection
- `trust_bundle_refresh_deadline` (String) deadline for refreshing the client trust bundle
- `trust_mode` (String) client trust mode: system or bundle
